name: Naruto
subtitle: The shinobi world
label: WILL OF FIRE
description: Ninja rivalries. Legendary jutsu. Unbreakable bonds.
creator: Masashi Kishimoto
premise: A young ninja pursues recognition and the title of Hokage while confronting rival clans, powerful enemies and the cycle of hatred.
powers: Chakra, ninjutsu, genjutsu, taijutsu and kekkei genkai.
watchNote: 220 Naruto episodes + 500 Shippuden episodes. Anime-only material and Boruto are outside this game’s ratings.

name: One Piece
subtitle: The Grand Line
label: SET SAIL
description: Wild adventures. Devil Fruits. A world without limits.
creator: Eiichiro Oda
premise: Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat crew sail the Grand Line in search of the One Piece and the freedom to follow their dreams.
powers: Devil Fruits, Haki, swordsmanship and inventive fighting styles.
watchNote: The story extends beyond our game’s chapter 1,122 cutoff. These length labels are lower bounds, not a live episode or chapter counter.

name: Bleach
subtitle: The Soul Society
label: SOUL REAPERS
description: Clashing blades. Bankai. Power beyond the living.
creator: Tite Kubo
premise: Ichigo Kurosaki becomes a Substitute Soul Reaper and protects the living and spirit worlds as rival factions clash over the balance of souls.
powers: Spiritual pressure, Zanpakuto, Shikai, Bankai and faction-specific abilities.
watchNote: The Thousand-Year Blood War adaptation is separate from the original 366-episode run. Extra chapters and sequels are outside this game’s chapter 686 cutoff.
